html: I forgot that I used Governor Locke for Levin. The suit needs work, and while the edit on the face is great, he looks a little too youthful and not so Presidential. Its why I like just keeping Silhouettes as from what I understand its difficult to properly change someone's expression in photoshop. Please don't spend an excessive amount of time on this project if you don't have to.
